failures.root_cause: stage_review skips generating review.md when no diff is found, but the test unconditionally asserts the file exists, causing a missing file error
failures.fix: create an empty review.md even when skipping review (no diff), or update the test to conditionally check for the file only when a diff is present

failures.root_cause: Intake stage enters CI branch path even when WORKSPACE_BRANCH is unset, printing 'CI mode: using workspace branch' in local mode and bypassing git checkout -b
failures.fix: Fix the WORKSPACE_BRANCH guard condition in intake so it only activates the CI path when WORKSPACE_BRANCH is non-empty (e.g., [ -n "${WORKSPACE_BRANCH:-}" ])
